description_en: Queries the full list of WAF domain names
description_zh: 调用DescribeCdnWafDomain查询WAF全量域名列表
kebab_example: aliyun cdn describe-cdn-waf-domain --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --resource-group-id 1234 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCdnWafDomain

parameters.help_en:
The WAF management region. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: the WAF management region for the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: the WAF management region for regions outside the Chinese mainland.

Regions outside the Chinese mainland include Hong Kong (China), Macao (China), Taiwan (China), and other countries and regions
parameters.help_zh:
WAF管控区域。取值：
cn-hangzhou：WAF中国内地（大陆）管控区域。
ap-southeast-1：WAF非中国内地（大陆）管控区域。

非中国内地（大陆）包含中国香港、中国澳门、中国台湾以及其他国家和地区
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name to query.

You can specify only one domain name in one of the following ways:
Exact domain name: If you specify example.com, the configuration information of example.com is queried.
Keyword: If you specify example, the configuration information of all domain names that contain example is queried.
Leave this parameter empty: All accelerated domain names for which WAF is enabled are returned by default
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的域名。

仅支持填写单个域名，详细见以下三种填写方式：
填写精确域名：例如example.com，则查询example.com域名的配置信息。
填写关键字：例如example，则查询所有包含example的域名配置信息。
不填该参数：则默认返回所有开通了WAF的加速域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

OutPutDomains.description_en: The information about the accelerated domain names

AclStatus.description_en:
The ACL status. Valid values:
0: disabled
1: enabled

CcStatus.description_en:
The CC status. Valid values:
0: disabled
1: enabled

Status.description_en:
The status of the WAF domain name. Valid values:
1: The WAF domain name is created or valid.
10: The WAF domain name is being created.
11: The WAF domain name failed to be created
Status.description_zh:
WAF域名状态。取值：
1：WAF域名创建成功或WAF域名有效。
10：WAF域名创建中。
11：WAF域名创建失败

WafStatus.description_en:
The WAF status. Valid values:
0: disabled
1: enabled

TotalCount.description_en: The number of accelerated domain names
